073/**
074 * SsTableModel provides an implementation of the TableModel interface. The
075 * SsDataGrid uses this class for providing a grid view for a RowSet.
076 * SsTableModel can be used without the SsDataGrid (e.g. in conjunction with a
077 * JTable), but the cell renderers and hidden columns features of the SsDataGrid
078 * will not be available.
079 * <p>
080SsTableModel can be used with a JTable to get a Grid view of the data.
081 */

083public class SsTableModel extends AbstractTableModel {

181  /**
182   * Deletes the specified JTable row from the database.
183   * The rows are numbered as: 0, 1, * ..., n-1
184   *
185   * @param row the row number to delete.
186   *
187   * @return returns true on succesful deletion else false.
188   */
189  public boolean deleteRow(int row) {
190    if (dataGridHandler != null) {
191      dataGridHandler.performPreDeletionOps(row);
192    }
193    if (row < rowCount) {
194      try {
195        if ((dataGridHandler != null) && !dataGridHandler.allowDeletion(row)) {
196          return false;
197        }
198        rowset.absolute(row + 1);
199        RowSetOps.deleteRow(rowset);
200        rowCount--;
201        if (dataGridHandler != null) {
202          dataGridHandler.performPostDeletionOps(row);
203        }
204        fireTableRowsDeleted(row, row);
205        return true;
206      } catch (final SQLException se) {
207        logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while deleting row.", se);
208        if (component != null) {
209          JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component, "Error while deleting row.\n" + se.getMessage());
210        }
211      }
212    }
213
214    return false;
215  }

283  /**
284   * Returns the number of rows in the model. A JTable uses this method to
285   * determine how many rows it should display.
286   *
287   * @return the number of rows in the SsTableModel
288   */
289  @Override
290  public int getRowCount() {
291    // RETURN THE NUMBER OF ROWS AS ONE GREATER THAN THOSE IN DATABASE
292    // ITS USED FOR INSERTING NEW ROWS
293    if (allowInsertion) {
294      return rowCount + 1;
295    }
296    // IF INSERTION IS NOT ALLOWED THEN RETURN THE ACTUAL ROW COUNT
297    return rowCount;
298  }

300  /**
301   * Returns the value for the cell at the specified row and column.
302   *
303   * @param row    the row whose value to be queried.
304   * @param column the column whose value to be queried.
305   *
306   * @return value at the requested cell.
307   */
308  @Override
309  public Object getValueAt(int row, int column) {
310    Object value = null;
311    if (row == rowCount) {
312      value = getDefaultValue(column);
313      return value;
314    }
315
316    try {
317      // ROW NUMBERS IN SSROWSET START FROM 1 WHERE AS ROW NUMBERING FOR JTABLE START
318      // FROM 0
319      rowset.absolute(row + 1);
320
321      // IF IT IS NULL RETURN NULL
322      if (rowset.getObject(column + 1) == null) {
323        return null;
324      }
325
326      // Column numbers in ssrowset start from 1 where as column numbering
327      // for jtable start from 0.
328      value = RowSetOps.getColumnObjectDirect(RSC.get(rowsModel, column + 1));
329    } catch (final SQLException se) {
330      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while retrieving value.", se);
331      if (component != null) {
332        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component,
333                                      "Error while retrieving value.\n" + se.getMessage());
334      }
335    }
336
337    return value;
338  }
339
340  /**
341   * Check if previous Java class column types are different from the rowset;
342   * save the new column types.
343   * @return true if different types
344   * @throws SQLException
345   */
346  private boolean columnTypesChanged() throws SQLException {
347    int newColumnCount = RowSetOps.getColumnCount(rowset);
348
349    List<Class<?>> colClasses = new ArrayList<>();
350    for (int col = 1; col <= newColumnCount; ++col) {
351      colClasses.add(RowSetOps.getClassColumnType(rowset, col));
352    }
353    if (colClasses.equals(columnClasses)) {
354      return false;
355    } else {
356      columnClasses = colClasses;
357      return true;
358    }
359  }

361  /**
362   * Initializes the SsTableModel. (Gets the column count and row count for the
363   * given RowSet.)
364   */
365  private void init(boolean inConstructor) {
366    try {
367      // If columnsChanged is true then will fireTableStructureChanged
368      boolean columnsChanged = columnTypesChanged();
369
370      columnCount = RowSetOps.getColumnCount(rowset);
371      rowset.last();
372      // ROWS IN THE SSROWSET ARE NUMBERED FROM 1, SO LAST ROW NUMBER GIVES THE
373      // ROW COUNT
374      rowCount = rowset.getRow();
375      rowset.first();
376
377      if (!inConstructor) {
378        // *** Following code added 11-01-2004 per forum suggestion from Diego Gil (dags).
379        // IF DATA CHANGES, ALERT LISTENERS
380        if (columnsChanged) {
381          fireTableStructureChanged();
382        } else {
383          fireTableDataChanged();
384        }
385        // *** End addition
386      }
387
388    } catch (final SQLException se) {
389      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception.", se);
390    }
391  }

393  /**
394   * Inserts a new row into the database. While doing so it inserts all the
395   * defaults provided by user and if the primary column is specified along with
396   * an SsDataValue implementation then the primary column value will be inserted.
397   *
398   * @param value  value entererd of a column
399   * @param column the column number for which the value is entered.
400   */
401  protected void insertRow(Object value, int column) {
402    if (value == null) {
403      return;
404    }
405    if (dataGridHandler != null) {
406      dataGridHandler.performPreInsertOps(rowCount);
407    }
408
409    try {
410      // IF NOT ON INSERT ROW MOVE TO INSERT ROW.
411      if (!inInsertRow) {
412        rowset.moveToInsertRow();
413        // SET THE DEFAULTS
414        setDefaults();
415        inInsertRow = true;
416        // IS SsDATAVALUE IS PROVIDED SET PRIMARY KEY VALUE
417        if (dataValue != null) {
418          setPrimaryColumn();
419        }
420      }
421
422      updateColumnObjectDirect(rowset, column + 1, value);
423
424      RowSetOps.insertRow(rowset);
425      if (rowCount != 0) {
426        rowset.moveToCurrentRow();
427      } else {
428        rowset.first();
429      }
430      rowset.refreshRow();
431
432      Supplier<String> text = () -> {
433        try {
434          return String.valueOf(rowset.getRow());
435        } catch (SQLException e) {
436          return "*** getRow() threw an SQLException ***";
437        }
438      };
439      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("Row number of inserted row : %s", text.get()));
440
441      inInsertRow = false;
442      rowCount++;
443
444      if (dataGridHandler != null) {
445        dataGridHandler.performPostInsertOps(rowCount - 1);
446      }
447      // If allowInsertion then add another empty insert row.
448      int newRow = allowInsertion ? rowCount : rowCount - 1;
449      fireTableRowsInserted(newRow, newRow);
450
451    } catch (final SQLException se) {
452      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while inserting row.", se);
453      inInsertRow = false;
454      if (component != null) {
455        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component, "Error while inserting row.\n" + se.getMessage());
456      }
457    }
458
459    logger.log(DEBUG, "Successfully added row.");
460  }

462  /**
463   * Returns true if the cell at rowIndex and columnIndex is editable. Otherwise,
464   * a call to setValueAt() on the cell will not change the value of that cell.
465   *
466   * @param row    the row whose value to be queried
467   * @param column the column whose value to be queried
468   *
469   * @return editable indicator for cell at row and column specified
470   */
471  @Override
472  public boolean isCellEditable(int row, int column) {
473    if (uneditableColumns != null) {
474      for (int i = 0; i < uneditableColumns.length; i++) {
475        if (column == uneditableColumns[i]) {
476          return false;
477        }
478      }
479    }
480
481    if (cellEditing != null) {
482      return cellEditing.isCellEditable(row, column);
483    }
484
485    return true;
486  }

488  /**
489   * This function sets the default values for the present row.
490   */
491  protected void setDefaults() {
492    if (defaultValuesMap == null) {
493      return;
494    }
495
496    final Set<Integer> keySet = defaultValuesMap.keySet();
497    final Iterator<?> iterator = keySet.iterator();
498    try {
499      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
500        final Integer column = (Integer) iterator.next();
501
502        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> "Column number is:" + column);
503
504        // COLUMNS SPECIFIED START FROM 0 BUT FOR SSROWSET THEY START FROM 1
505        //final int type = rowset.getColumnType(column.intValue() + 1);
506        updateColumnObjectDirect(rowset, column + 1, defaultValuesMap.get(column));
507
508      } // END OF WHILE
509
510    } catch (final SQLException se) {
511      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while setting defaults for row.", se);
512      if (component != null) {
513        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component,
514                                      "Error while setting defaults for row.\n" + se.getMessage());
515      }
516    }
517  } // end protected void setDefaults() {
518
519  /**
520   * Sets the default values for different columns. These values will be used
521   * while inserting a new row.
522   *
523   * @param columnNumbers the column numbers for which defaults are required
524   * @param values        the values for all the columns specified in first
525   *                       argument
526   */
527  public void setDefaultValues(int[] columnNumbers, Object[] values) {
528    if ((columnNumbers == null) || (values == null)) {
529      defaultValuesMap = null;
530    }
531
532    if (defaultValuesMap == null) {
533      defaultValuesMap = new HashMap<>();
534    } else {
535      defaultValuesMap.clear();
536    }
537    if ((columnNumbers != null) && (values != null)) {
538      for (int i = 0; i < columnNumbers.length; i++) {
539        defaultValuesMap.put(columnNumbers[i], values[i]);
540      }
541    }
542  }

555  /**
556   * Sets row insertion indicator; fireEvent so insertion row
557   * is displayed. Note: must not be called directly, only through
558   * SsDataGrid.
559   *
560   * @param insert true if user can insert new rows, else false.
561   */
562  public void setInsertion(boolean insert) {
563    boolean change = allowInsertion != insert;
564    allowInsertion = insert;
565    // rowCount is the JTABLE index of the row after the database rows
566    if (change) {
567      if (insert)
568        fireTableRowsInserted(rowCount, rowCount);
569      else
570        fireTableRowsDeleted(rowCount, rowCount);
571    }
572  }

669  /**
670   * Sets the value in the cell at row and column to value.
671   *
672   * @param value  the new value
673   * @param row    the row whose value is to be changed
674   * @param column the column whose value is to be changed
675   */
676  @Override
677  public void setValueAt(Object value, int row, int column) {
678    // MAKE LOCAL COPY OF OBJECT FOR DATE MANIPULATIONS
679    Object valueCopy = value;
680
681    // GET THE TYPE OF THE COLUMN
682    JDBCType type;
683    try {
684      //type = rowset.getColumnType(column + 1);
685      type = RowSetOps.getJDBCColumnType(rowset, column + 1);
686    } catch (final SQLException se) {
687      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while updating value.", se);
688      if (component != null) {
689        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component, "Error while updating value.\n" + se.getMessage());
690      }
691      return;
692    }
693
694    // TODO Clean this up. Utilize java.util.Time.
695
696    // If copying values the date will come as string so convert it to date object.
697    if (DateTime.isHandledDateTimeJDBCType(type) && valueCopy instanceof String string) {
698      valueCopy = getSQLDateTimeObject(string, RSC.get(rowsModel, column + 1));
699    }
700
701    // IF CELL EDITING INTERFACE IMPLEMENTATION IS PROVIDED INFO THE USER
702    // THAT AN UPDATE FOR CELL HAS BEEN REQUESTED.
703    if (cellEditing != null) {
704      // THE ROW AND COLUMN NUMBERING STARTS FROM 0 FOR JTABLE BUT THE COLUMNS AND
705      // ROWS ARE NUMBERED FROM 1 FOR SSROWSET.
706      boolean allowEdit;
707
708      // IF ITS NEW ROW SEND A NULL FOR THE OLD VALUE
709      if (row == rowCount) {
710        allowEdit = cellEditing.cellUpdateRequested(row, column, null, valueCopy);
711      } else {
712        allowEdit
713            = cellEditing.cellUpdateRequested(row, column, getValueAt(row, column), valueCopy);
714      }
715
716      // IF THE USER DOES NOT PERMIT THE UPDATE RETURN ELSE GO AHEAD AND UPDATE THE
717      // DATABASE.
718      if (!allowEdit) {
719        return;
720      }
721    }
722
723    // IF CHANGE IS MADE IN INSERT ROW ADD ROW TO THE DATABASE
724    // INSERTROW FUNCTION ALSO INCREMENTS THE ROW COUNT
725    if (row == rowCount) {
726      insertRow(valueCopy, column);
727      return;
728    }
729
730    var finalValueCopy = valueCopy;
731    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> "Set value at " + row + "  " + column + " with " + finalValueCopy);
732
733    try {
734      // YOU SHOULD BE ON THE RIGHT ROW IN THE SSROWSET
735      if (rowset.getRow() != (row + 1)) {
736        rowset.absolute(row + 1);
737      }
738      if (valueCopy == null) {
739        rowset.updateNull(column + 1);
740        return;
741      }
742
743      updateColumnObjectDirect(rowset, column + 1, valueCopy);
744
745      RowSetOps.updateRow(rowset);
746
747      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("Updated value: %s.", getValueAt(row, column)));
748    } catch (final SQLException se) {
749      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception while updating value.", se);
750      if (component != null) {
751        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(component, "Error while updating value.\n" + se.getMessage());
752      }
753    }
754  }
755}
